messages:
olivia: Heads up — want to align on new KV/prefix cache metrics we need for the Console dashboard. Can runtime/infra list exact counters + labels you can emit? Will feed into rollout UX and quotas.

raj: We can emit: kv_cache_hits_total{workload,model_variant,region,cache_type}, kv_cache_misses_total{workload,model_variant,region,cache_type}, kv_cache_evictions_total{workload,reason,cache_type}, kv_cache_entries_gauge{cache_type}, kv_cache_kv_warmth_ratio{workload}. Also can emit prefix_reuse_count{prefix_len_bucket,workload,cache_type}.

mike: Cardinality warning — workload+model_variant+route will explode. Suggest we limit labels to: workload, cache_tier, region. If product needs route-level, emit sampled or only top routes.

zoe: For observability: also want histograms for lookup latency: kv_cache_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket{le,cache_type}. Add a boolean tag cold_start=true/false.

dan: From the Console UX POV we need per-workload hit rate, evictions per 100k requests, and reuse-by-workload trends (7d/30d). These tie into routing fallback heuristics.

raj: Agree on normalized metrics. Example hit rate PromQL: 
```
100 * (sum by (workload) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]))) / (sum by (workload) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses_total[5m])))
```
This gives per-workload percent.

mike: Small bug in that expression — need separate sums for numerator and denominator to avoid grouping mismatch. Use: 
```
100 * sum by (workload)(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (workload)(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses_total[5m]))
```

zoe: For dashboards we'll want 1m/5m pre-aggregates. Retention plan: full-resolution 90d for low-cardinality metrics, but high-cardinality labels (model_variant, route) only 30d.

raj: Eviction reasons we'll standardize to: "size", "ttl", "policy". Emit kv_cache_evictions_total{reason}. Also emit kv_cache_eviction_age_seconds_sum/count to measure age distribution.

olivia: Can runtime attach a workload_name label (human-friendly)? Product wants readable names in the Console.

raj: We can emit workload_name but that increases cardinality. Proposal: emit workload_name only for top-1000 active workloads; for others emit workload_id and expose a join in the Console mapping table.

mike: Ingestion quotas: if we add workload_name for top N, we still need to enforce per-tenant label cardinality limits in pipeline. I'll draft concrete limits (max 10 labels per metric, max 5k unique workload_name/day).

zoe: Also want a sample alert: low hit rate on critical workloads -> trigger rollback/canary fallback. Suggested alert query: 
```
(sum by (workload)(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (workload)(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses_total[5m]))) < 0.2
```
with suppression for workloads with <100 reqs/min.

raj: For prefix reuse we can emit prefix_len_bucket (0-8,9-16,17-32,33+) and prefix_reuse_ratio{workload}. That should help identify prompt patterns worth prefetching.

mike: Implementation note: avoid high-cardinality label 'prompt_hash'. Use prefix_len and workload only. Also add a sampling flag for raw prefix values for offline analysis.

zoe: Dashboard wireframe needs: global hit rate, per-workload top 20, eviction waterfall (size/ttl/policy), prefix reuse heatmap (len x workload), lookup latency histogram.

raj: Will add metrics endpoints by EOD Wed. We plan to add an opt-in flag in runtime config: metrics.v2.kv_prefix: true. Canary deploy to internal first.

metrics-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime-metrics-v2 -> canary group 'internal' at 2025-11-12T22:00Z.

dan: Next steps: raj send final metric list + PromQL examples by EOD Thursday, zoe draft dashboard wireframes (Figma link), mike to review cardinality limits & ingestion quotas, olivia to update rollout UX doc with new triggers.

olivia: Great — sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
